context: Mei and Ren relax at a cozy cafe.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (甘い/カップ/素材/快適/過ぎる) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: このカフェ、すごく快適だね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、椅子もカップも、いい感じだね。
lines.en: Yeah, the chairs and cups feel nice.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: このケーキ、甘さがちょうどいいの。
lines.en: This cake's sweetness is just right.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 甘過ぎなくて、食べやすいね。
lines.en: Not too sweet, easy to eat.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素材に、こだわってるんだろうね。
lines.en: They must be particular about ingredients.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 良い素材だと、味が違うよね。
lines.en: With good ingredients, the taste is different.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カップが温かくて、手が快適だな。
lines.en: The cup is warm and comfortable in my hands.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 時間が過ぎるのも、忘れちゃうね。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
